event_chain.summary: Network intrusion; employee data taken (method not disclosed)

summary: Lighthouse Electric Company, Inc. of Canonsburg, Pennsylvania suffered a targeted data security incident on its computer network on October 21, 2024, discovered December 23, 2024. The personal information of about 7,128 current and former employees and others (names, Social Security numbers, financial account details and health insurance information) was compromised. The RansomHub ransomware gang claimed the attack. Notices went out February 4, 2025, and a class action (Brown and Gerken v. Lighthouse Electric Co.) was settled in 2026.
